name: The Croaker
storyline: One day, Jeremy J. Croaker was wandering around searching for food, when he ended up trespassing onto Virtual Guy's property. After seeing Jeremy had eaten some of Virtual Guy's apples, Virtual Guy threw Jeremy into a simulation designed to make him suffer. However, 18 levels later, a huge memory leak causes the entire simulation to explode, thus setting Jeremy free into the deep underground that the computer was stored in. Jeremy ends up working his way back up towards society, where he finally enters the City. From here, Jeremy meets Sir Croakington, who is the best inventor of his time. Sir Croakington makes Jeremy a flame-proof suit and tells him that the only way to escape the range of Virtual Guy is to let a volcano blow him far away. Jeremy then works his way down into the underneath of the volcano, and eventually makes his way into the throat of the volcano, where the volcano erupts and sets Jeremy free.
summary:
The Croaker is a very fun, feature-packed game where you can collect apples. Where's the fun in that? Well, these apples you collect are used all throughout the game: You can buy skins, powerups, unlock many achievements, and compete on leaderboards against the top players!

There are 50 campaign levels, where the protagonist, Jeremy, gets trapped in a simulation and must escape without the antagonist of Virtual Guy finding him. Not only that, there are going to be brand new Bonus Levels every few updates just to keep adding content to the game.
